audience: As a candidate for this exam, you aspire to understand how Microsoft Power Platform technologies can be used to:
Optimize your use of data by using Microsoft Dataverse and connectors.
Accelerate business outcomes by using AI-powered solutions in Microsoft Power Apps.
Automate business processes by using Microsoft Power Automate.
Boost your productivity and create agents by using Copilot Studio.
The exam is intended for you if you’re seeking to start your journey building solutions with Microsoft Power Platform.
You can use this exam to prepare for role-based certifications, but it’s not a prerequisite for any of them.
